identity_notes.model_id_note: model.id is SPARK_MUSE_GLIMMER_SERVING_DRIVER_MODEL_ID: the serving adapter sends it as driver_model_id and serving_adapter_template.c refuses a driver whose descriptor differs with TARGET_MISMATCH.
identity_notes.revision_note: model.revision is the contract source_revision, the checkpoint revision the builds pass as MUSE_MODEL_REVISION and tools/muse_gen_deployment.py writes as model_revision.
identity_notes.target_note: the stage target and operation module are the muse module's MODULE_TARGET and MODULE_IDENTIFIER; tools/muse_gen_deployment.py writes the same target as each node's node_target.

metadata.purpose: resident decode-stage firmware for Muse-Glimmer-30B, text tower only: dense GQA with 3:1 sliding-window (2048) to full attention, NoPE full-attention layers, elementwise sigmoid output gate, dense SwiGLU MLP, BF16 weights and KV cache, no MTP
